learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about our beautiful country India and how we all are one big family!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Our country is named India. It is a very big and beautiful place to live.
People in India may speak differently and wear different clothes, but we are all friends.
We love our country and our beautiful flag with three colors.

fun_activity.title: 🇮🇳 Draw Our Flag
fun_activity.instructions: Draw the Indian flag and color it with Saffron, White, and Green crayons. Don't forget the blue wheel in the middle!

quick_recap: ⭐ We are all Indians and we love each other.
⭐ We respect our flag and stand together.
